primary.citation: Ogden FL, Lai W, Steinke RC, Zhu J, Talbot CA (2015), A new general 1-D vadose zone flow solution method, Water Resources Research 51
source_bound_claims: falling slugs occur during rainfall or snowmelt hiatus when infiltrated water detaches from the surface
capillary gradient is approximated as zero and gravity is the driving force
the falling rate is the incremental hydraulic conductivity component of the water-content bin
top and bottom ends of a slug have the same velocity, preserving slug length during the advective step
equation 19 itself is not inherently mass conservative; conservation is imposed by finite-volume water bookkeeping

source_provenance.equation_rendering_crosscheck: Public finite-water-content method summary renders equation 19 as dz_j/dt = [K(theta_j)-K(theta_{j-1})]/[theta_j-theta_{j-1}]. This gate does not claim official M2WC70 source reproduction.

candidate.theta_discretization: uniform fixed water-content bins between theta_r and theta_s
candidate.constitutive_evaluation: Mualem-van Genuchten K(theta) using the Staringreeks 2018 KSATFIT parameters already frozen in SWAP5 F-ROSS01 C1 catalog
candidate.slug_state: top and bottom coordinates plus bin identity in the qualified fixed-slot representation
candidate.water_storage_per_slug: Delta_theta times in-domain slug length, in cm water depth per unit area
candidate.advective_update: top and bottom coordinates translated by exactly v_j*dt
candidate.bottom_boundary: geometric exit from the finite column is ledgered as outflow; truncation at the physical domain boundary is not numerical clipping repair
candidate.overflow_policy: reject trial unchanged and emit FALLBACK_REQUIRED

required_cases: fully internal slug translation with no boundary contact
partial boundary exit over multiple accepted steps
multiple independent bins/slugs without collision or capillary relaxation
intentional ninth-slot overflow as a rejected trial
mass_identity: initial_storage - cumulative_bottom_outflow - final_storage = residual for the no-inflow falling-slug fixture
hard_nonclaims: No hydraulic accuracy comparison against FullRichards.
No claim that eight slots give acceptable fallback incidence or MultiSWAP throughput.
hard_guards: Do not infer the 2016 explicit-diffusion equations from the advective falling-slug formula.
Do not use capillary relaxation to hide a slot overflow in this gate.
Do not repair mass by clipping storage values.
Only physical domain-boundary truncation with an equal ledgered outflow is allowed.
Do not promote this narrow subgate to full FWC or MultiSWAP admission.
